name: yamlet-pi
description: Spec-driven development with yamlet for the pi coding agent: an interviewing author drills you down to minimal, testable `.yamlet.yaml` specs with EARS acceptance criteria, appending through the `yamlet` CLI so the file is correct by construction. Two adversarial challengers guard the immutable init/commit gates. Requires the `yamlet` CLI on PATH; the challengers additionally require @tintinweb/pi-subagents.
